1.text: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by tha will of God, 2 tha saints which r at Ephesus, N 2 tha faithful in Christ Jesus:
Grace be 2 u, N peace, from God our Father, N from tha Lord Jesus Christ.
Blessed be tha God N Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who has blessed us wit all spiritual blessings in heavenly places in Christ:
According as he has chosen us in him before tha foundation of tha world, dat we should be holy N without blame before him in love:
Havin predestinated us 2 tha adoption of children by Jesus Christ 2 himself, according 2 tha good pleasure of his will,
2 tha praise of tha glory of his grace, in which he has made us accepted in tha beloved.
In whom we have redemption through his blood, tha forgiveness of sins, according 2 tha riches of his grace;
In which he has abounded toward us in all wisdom N prudence;
Havin made known 2 us tha mystery of his will, according 2 his good pleasure which he has purposed in himself:
Dat in tha dispensation of tha fulness of times he might gather together in one all things in Christ, both which r in heaven, N which r on earth; even in him:
In whom also we have obtained an inheritance, bein predestinated according 2 tha purpose of him who works all things after tha counsel of his own will:
Dat we should be 2 tha praise of his glory, who first trusted in Christ.
In whom y’all also trusted, after dat y’all heard tha word of truth, tha gospel of ur salvation: in whom also after dat y’all believed, y’all were sealed wit dat holy Spirit of promise,
Which is tha earnest of our inheritance until tha redemption of tha purchased possession, 2 tha praise of his glory.
So I also, after I heard of ur faith in tha Lord Jesus, N love 2 all tha saints,
Cease not 2 give thanks 4 u, makin mention of u in my prayers;
Dat tha God of our Lord Jesus Christ, tha Father of glory, may give 2 u tha spirit of wisdom N revelation in tha knowledge of him:
Tha eyes of ur understanding bein enlightened; dat y’all may know what is tha hope of his callin, N what tha riches of tha glory of his inheritance in tha saints,
N what is tha exceeding greatness of his power 2 us-ward who believe, according 2 tha workin of his mighty power,
Which he wrought in Christ, when he raised him from tha dead, N set him at his own right hand in tha heavenly places,
Far above all principality, N power, N might, N dominion, N every name dat is named, not only in dis world, but also in dat which is 2 come:
N has put all things under his feet, N gave him 2 be tha head over all things 2 tha church,
Which is his body, tha fulness of him dat fills all in all.

2.text: N u has he quickened, who were dead in trespasses N sins;
In which in time past y’all walked according 2 tha course of dis world, according 2 tha prince of tha power of tha air, tha spirit dat now works in tha children of disobedience:
Among whom also we all had our conversation in times past in tha lusts of our flesh, fulfilling tha desires of tha flesh N of tha mind; N were by nature tha children of wrath, even as others.
But God, who is rich in mercy, 4 his great love wherewith he loved us,
Even when we were dead in sins, has quickened us together wit Christ, (by grace y’all r saved;)
N has raised us up together, N made us sit together in heavenly places in Christ Jesus:
Dat in tha ages 2 come he might show tha exceeding riches of his grace in his kindness toward us through Christ Jesus.
4 by grace r y’all saved through faith; N dat not of y’all: it is tha gift of God:
Not of works, lest any man should boast.
4 we r his workmanship, created in Christ Jesus 2 good works, which God has before ordained dat we should walk in ’em.
So remember, dat y’all bein in time past Gentiles in tha flesh, who r called Uncircumcision by dat which is called tha Circumcision in tha flesh made by hands;
Dat at dat time y’all were without Christ, bein aliens from tha commonwealth of Israel, N strangers from tha covenants of promise, havin no hope, N without God in tha world:
But now in Christ Jesus y’all who sometimes were far off r made nigh by tha blood of Christ.
4 he is our peace, who has made both one, N has broken down tha middle wall of partition between us;
Havin abolished in his flesh tha enmity, even tha law of commandments contained in ordinances; 4 2 make in himself of twain one new man, so makin peace;
N dat he might reconcile both 2 God in one body by tha cross, havin killed tha enmity by dat:
N came N preached peace 2 u which were afar off, N 2 ’em dat were nigh.
4 through him we both have access by one Spirit 2 tha Father.
Now therefore y’all r no more strangers N foreigners, but fellowcitizens wit tha saints, N of tha household of God;
N r built upon tha foundation of tha apostles N prophets, Jesus Christ himself bein tha chief corner stone;
In whom all tha buildin fitly framed together grows 2 an holy temple in tha Lord:
In whom y’all also r builded together 4 an habitation of God through tha Spirit.

3.text: 4 dis cause I Paul, tha prisoner of Jesus Christ 4 u Gentiles,
If y’all have heard of tha dispensation of tha grace of God which is given me 2 u-ward:
How dat by revelation he made known 2 me tha mystery; (as I wrote afore in few words,
Whereby, when y’all read, y’all may understand my knowledge in tha mystery of Christ)
Which in other ages was not made known 2 tha sons of men, as it is now revealed 2 his holy apostles N prophets by tha Spirit;
Dat tha Gentiles should be fellowheirs, N of tha same body, N partakers of his promise in Christ by tha gospel:
Whereof I was made a minister, according 2 tha gift of tha grace of God given 2 me by tha effectual workin of his power.
2 me, who am less than tha least of all saints, is dis grace given, dat I should preach among tha Gentiles tha unsearchable riches of Christ;
N 2 make all men see what is tha fellowship of tha mystery, which from tha beginning of tha world has been hid in God, who created all things by Jesus Christ:
2 tha intent dat now 2 tha principalities N powers in heavenly places might be known by tha church tha manifold wisdom of God,
According 2 tha eternal purpose which he purposed in Christ Jesus our Lord:
In whom we have boldness N access wit confidence by tha faith of him.
So I desire dat y’all faint not at my tribulations 4 u, which is ur glory.
4 dis cause I bow my knees 2 tha Father of our Lord Jesus Christ,
Of whom tha whole family in heaven N earth is named,
Dat he would grant u, according 2 tha riches of his glory, 2 be strengthened wit might by his Spirit in tha inner man;
Dat Christ may live in ur hearts by faith; dat y’all, bein rooted N grounded in love,
May be able 2 comprehend wit all saints what is tha breadth, N length, N depth, N height;
N 2 know tha love of Christ, which passes knowledge, dat y’all might be filled wit all tha fulness of God.
Now 2 him dat is able 2 do exceeding abundantly above all dat we ask or think, according 2 tha power dat works in us,
2 him be glory in tha church by Christ Jesus throughout all ages, world without end. Amen.

4.text: I therefore, tha prisoner of tha Lord, beg u dat y’all walk worthy of tha vocation wherewith y’all r called,
Wit all lowliness N meekness, wit longsuffering, forbearing one another in love;
Endeavouring 2 keep tha unity of tha Spirit in tha bond of peace.
There is one body, N one Spirit, even as y’all r called in one hope of ur callin;
One Lord, one faith, one baptism,
One God N Father of all, who is above all, N through all, N in u all.
But 2 every one of us is given grace according 2 tha measure of tha gift of Christ.
So he says, When he ascended up on high, he led captivity captive, N gave gifts 2 men.
(Now dat he ascended, what is it but dat he also descended first in2 tha lower parts of tha earth?
He dat descended is tha same also dat ascended up far above all heavenz, dat he might fill all things.)
N he gave some, apostles; N some, prophets; N some, evangelists; N some, pastors N teachers;
4 tha perfecting of tha saints, 4 tha work of tha ministry, 4 tha edifying of tha body of Christ:
Till we all come in tha unity of tha faith, N of tha knowledge of tha Son of God, 2 a perfect man, 2 tha measure of tha stature of tha fulness of Christ:
Dat we from now on be no more children, tossed 2 N fro, N carried about wit every wind of doctrine, by tha sleight of men, N cunning craftiness, whereby dey lie in wait 2 deceive;
But speakin tha truth in love, may grow up in2 him in all things, which is tha head, even Christ:

From whom tha whole body fitly joined together N compacted by dat which every joint supplieth, according 2 tha effectual workin in tha measure of every part, makes increase of tha body 2 tha edifying of itself in love.
Dis I say therefore, N testify in tha Lord, dat y’all from now on walk not as other Gentiles walk, in tha vanity of their mind,
Havin tha understanding darkened, bein alienated from tha life of God through tha ignorance dat is in ’em, because of tha blindness of their heart:
Who bein past feeling have given themselves over 2 lasciviousness, 2 work all uncleanness wit greediness.
But y’all have not so learned Christ;
If so be dat y’all have heard him, N have been taught by him, as tha truth is in Jesus:
Dat y’all put off concerning tha former conversation tha old man, which is corrupt according 2 tha deceitful lusts;
N be renewed in tha spirit of ur mind;
N dat y’all put on tha new man, which after God is created in righteousness N true holiness.
So puttin away lyin, speak every man truth wit his neighbour: 4 we r members one of another.
Be y’all angry, N sin not: don’t let tha sun go down upon ur wrath:
Neither give place 2 tha devil.
Let him dat stole steal no more: but rather let him labour, workin wit his hands tha thing which is good, dat he may have 2 give 2 him dat needeth.
Let no corrupt communication proceed out of ur mouth, but dat which is good 2 tha use of edifying, dat it may minister grace 2 tha hearers.
N grieve not tha holy Spirit of God, whereby y’all r sealed 2 tha day of redemption.
Let all bitterness, N wrath, N anger, N clamour, N evil speakin, be put away from u, wit all malice:
N be y’all kind one 2 another, tenderhearted, forgiving one another, even as God 4 Christ’s sake has forgiven u.

5.text: Be y’all therefore followers of God, as dear children;
N walk in love, as Christ also has loved us, N has given himself 4 us an offering N a sacrifice 2 God 4 a sweetsmelling savour.
But fornication, N all uncleanness, or covetousness, let it not be once named among u, as becomes saints;
Neither filthiness, nor foolish talking, nor jesting, which r not convenient: but rather givin of thanks.
4 dis y’all know, dat no whoremonger, nor unclean person, nor covetous man, who is an idolater, has any inheritance in tha kingdom of Christ N of God.
Let no man deceive u wit vain words: 4 because of dese things comes tha wrath of God upon tha children of disobedience.
Don’t be y’all therefore partakers wit ’em.
4 y’all were sometimes darkness, but now r y’all light in tha Lord: walk as children of light:
(4 tha fruit of tha Spirit is in all goodness N righteousness N truth;)
Proving what is acceptable 2 tha Lord.
N have no fellowship wit tha unfruitful works of darkness, but rather reprove ’em.
4 it is a shame even 2 speak of dose things which r done of ’em in secret.
But all things dat r reproved r made manifest by tha light: 4 whatever does make manifest is light.
So he says, Awake u dat sleep, N arise from tha dead, N Christ shall give u light.
See then dat y’all walk circumspectly, not as fools, but as wise,
Redeeming tha time, because tha days r evil.
So be y’all not unwise, but understanding what tha will of tha Lord is.
N don’t be drunk wit wine, in which is excess; but be filled wit tha Spirit;
Speakin 2 y’all in psalms N hymns N spiritual songs, singin N makin melody in ur heart 2 tha Lord;
Givin thanks always 4 all things 2 God N tha Father in tha name of our Lord Jesus Christ;
Submitting y’all one 2 another in tha fear of God.
Wives, submit y’all 2 ur own husbands, as 2 tha Lord.
4 tha husband is tha head of tha wife, even as Christ is tha head of tha church: N he is tha saviour of tha body.
Therefore as tha church is subject 2 Christ, so let tha wives be 2 their own husbands in every thing.
Husbands, love ur wives, even as Christ also loved tha church, N gave himself 4 it;
Dat he might sanctify N cleanse it wit tha washing of water by tha word,
Dat he might present it 2 himself a glorious church, not havin spot, or wrinkle, or any such thing; but dat it should be holy N without blemish.
So ought men 2 love their wives as their own bodies. He dat loves his wife loves himself.
4 no man ever yet hated his own flesh; but nourisheth N cherisheth it, even as tha Lord tha church:
4 we r members of his body, of his flesh, N of his bones.
4 dis cause shall a man leave his father N mother, N shall be joined 2 his wife, N dey two shall be one flesh.
Dis is a great mystery: but I speak concerning Christ N tha church.
Nevertheless let every one of u in particular so love his wife even as himself; N tha wife see dat she reverence her husband.

6.text: Children, obey ur parents in tha Lord: 4 dis is right.
Honour ur father N mother; (which is tha first commandment wit promise;)
Dat it may be well wit u, N u may live long on tha earth.
N, y’all fathers, provoke not ur children 2 wrath: but bring ’em up in tha nurture N admonition of tha Lord.
Servants, be obedient 2 ’em dat r ur masters according 2 tha flesh, wit fear N tremblin, in singleness of ur heart, as 2 Christ;
Not wit eyeservice, as menpleasers; but as tha servants of Christ, doin tha will of God from tha heart;
Wit good will doin service, as 2 tha Lord, N not 2 men:
Knowin dat whatever good thing any man does, tha same shall he receive of tha Lord, whether he be bond or free.
N, y’all masters, do tha same things 2 ’em, forbearing threatening: knowin dat ur Master also is in heaven; neither is there respect of persons wit him.
Finally, my brothers, be strong in tha Lord, N in tha power of his might.
Put on tha whole armour of God, dat y’all may be able 2 stand against tha wiles of tha devil.
4 we wrestle not against flesh N blood, but against principalities, against powers, against tha rulers of tha darkness of dis world, against spiritual wickedness in high places.
So take 2 u tha whole armour of God, dat y’all may be able 2 withstand in tha evil day, N havin done all, 2 stand.
Stand therefore, havin ur loins girt about wit truth, N havin on tha breastplate of righteousness;
N ur feet shod wit tha preparation of tha gospel of peace;
Above all, takin tha shield of faith, wherewith y’all shall be able 2 quench all tha fiery darts of tha wicked.
N take tha helmet of salvation, N tha sword of tha Spirit, which is tha word of God:
Prayin always wit all prayer N supplication in tha Spirit, N watchin thereunto wit all perseverance N supplication 4 all saints;
N 4 me, dat utterance may be given 2 me, dat I may open my mouth boldly, 2 make known tha mystery of tha gospel,
4 which I am an ambassador in bonds: dat in it I may speak boldly, as I ought 2 speak.
But dat y’all also may know my affairs, N how I do, Tychicus, a beloved brother N faithful minister in tha Lord, shall make known 2 u all things:
Whom I have sent 2 u 4 tha same purpose, dat y’all might know our affairs, N dat he might comfort ur hearts.
Peace be 2 tha brothers, N love wit faith, from God tha Father N tha Lord Jesus Christ.
Grace be wit all ’em dat love our Lord Jesus Christ in sincerity. Amen.
